name: World War I
info: Global conflict centered in Europe between the Allied and Central Powers

nested.name: Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand
nested.info: Assassination in Sarajevo triggers the chain of events leading to war

nested.name: Battle of Verdun
nested.info: Longest single battle of the war. French defensive victory.

nested.name: Armistice
nested.info: Fighting ends at 11 AM on the 11th day of the 11th month

name: World War II
info: Global conflict between the Allies and the Axis powers

nested.name: Attack on Pearl Harbor
nested.info: Japan attacks the US Pacific Fleet, bringing America into the war

nested.name: Battle of Stalingrad
nested.info: Bloodiest battle in history. Soviet victory marks the turning point on the Eastern Front.

nested.name: D-Day
nested.info: Allied invasion of Normandy. Largest seaborne invasion in history.

nested.name: V-E Day
nested.info: Victory in Europe. Germany surrenders unconditionally.
